35819-lonesome-town.title: Lonesome Town
35819-lonesome-town.creator: Unknown
35819-lonesome-town.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The man removed his white sombrero and mopped his brow with a purple bandanna. The fingers with which he combed back his moist thatch nicely matched the hair in color--sunburn brown. His head bulged slightly at the back, but was balanced on a neck and shoulders splendidly proportioned.

arxiv-2203-07772.title: Fast Autofocusing using Tiny Transformer Networks for Digital Holographic Microscopy
arxiv-2203-07772.creator: Stéphane Cuenat, Louis Andréoli, Antoine N.André, Patrick Sandoz
arxiv-2203-07772.description: Abstract The numerical wavefront backpropagation principle of digital holography confers unique extended focus capabilities, without mechanical displacements along z-axis. However, the determination of the correct focusing distance is a non-trivial and time consuming issue. A deep learning (DL) solution is proposed to cast the autofocusing as a regression problem and tested over both experimental and simulated holograms.

arxiv-2206-02200.title: GridShift: A Faster Mode-seeking Algorithm for Image Segmentation and Object Tracking
arxiv-2206-02200.creator: Abhishek Kumar, Oladayo S. Ajani, Swagatam Das, Rammohan Mallipeddi
arxiv-2206-02200.description: Abstract In machine learning and computer vision, mean shift (MS) qualifies as one of the most popular mode-seeking algorithms used for clustering and image segmentation. It iteratively moves each data point to the weighted mean of its neighborhood data points. The computational cost required to find the neighbors of each data point is quadratic to the number of data points.

arxiv-2209-07235.title: Sound and Complete Verification of Polynomial Networks
arxiv-2209-07235.creator: Elias Abad Rocamora, Mehmet Fatih Sahin, Fanghui Liu, Grigorios G Chrysos, Volkan Cevher
arxiv-2209-07235.description: Abstract Polynomial Networks (PNs) have demonstrated promising performance on face and image recognition recently. However, robustness of PNs is unclear and thus obtaining certificates becomes imperative for enabling their adoption in real-world applications. Existing verification algorithms on ReLU neural networks (NNs) based on classical branch and bound (BaB) techniques cannot be trivially applied to PN verification.

arxiv-2308-08818.title: User-Pair Selection for QoS-Aware Secrecy Rate Maximization in Untrusted NOMA
arxiv-2308-08818.creator: Sapna Thapar 1 , Deepak Mishra 2 , Ravikant Saini 1 , and Zhiguo Ding 3
arxiv-2308-08818.description: Abstract Non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) has been recognized as one of the key enabling technologies for future generation wireless networks. Sharing the same time-frequency resource among users imposes secrecy challenges in NOMA in the presence of untrusted users. This paper characterizes the impact of user-pair selection on the secrecy performance of an untrusted NOMA system.

arxiv-2311-16442.title: Fast and Efficient 2-bit LLM Inference on GPU: 2/4/16-bit in a Weight Matrix with Asynchronous Dequantization Conference: IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design; October 27–31, 2024; New York, NY, USA IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD ’24), October
arxiv-2311-16442.creator: Jinhao Li 1∗ , Jiaming Xu 13∗ , Shiyao Li 23 , Shan Huang 1 , Jun Liu 1 , Yaoxiu Lian 1 , Guohao Dai 13†
arxiv-2311-16442.description: Abstract . Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive abilities in various domains while the inference cost is expensive. Many previous studies exploit quantization methods to reduce LLM inference cost by reducing latency and memory consumption. Applying 2-bit single-precision weight quantization brings > > 3% accuracy loss, so the state-of-the-art methods use mixed-precision methods for LLMs ( e.g. Llama2-7b, etc.

arxiv-2410-06636.title: Bridging inflation and reheating: chiral gravitational waves from aHz to GHz
arxiv-2410-06636.creator: Chengjie Fu, Chao Chen, Yi Wang
arxiv-2410-06636.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate chiral gravitational wave (GW) signals generated from inflation to reheating, driven by a parity-violating (PV) term coupled to the inflaton, ϕ ˙ ​ ϵ i ​ j ​ k ​ h i ​ l ​ ∂ j h k l \dot{\phi}\epsilon^{ijk}h_{il}\partial_{j}h_{k}^{l} , which naturally arises in PV extensions of teleparallel gravity.

arxiv-2511-20272.title: V Know U: Evaluating V isual Know ledge Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
arxiv-2511-20272.creator: Tianxiang Jiang, Sheng Xia, Yicheng Xu, Linquan Wu, Xiangyu Zeng, Limin Wang, Yu Qiao, Yi Wang
arxiv-2511-20272.description: Abstract While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have become adept at recognizing objects, they often lack the intuitive, human-like understanding of the world’s underlying physical and social principles. This high-level vision-grounded semantics, which we term visual knowledge , forms a bridge between perception and reasoning, yet remains an underexplored area in current MLLMs.

pmc-11488104.title: Hypoxia-driven M2-polarized macrophages facilitate the epithelial-mesenchymal transition of glioblastoma via extracellular vesicles
pmc-11488104.creator: Liang Liu, Ran Wang, Aogesi Alifu, Yong Xiao, Yong Liu, Chunfa Qian, Mengjie Zhao, Xianglong Tang, Yandong Xie, Yan Shi, Yuanjie Zou, Hong Xiao, Kun Yang, Hongyi Liu
pmc-11488104.description: Rationale: M2-like tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) promote the malignant progression of glioblastomas. However, the mechanisms responsible for this phenomenon remain unclear.Methods: RT-PCR, Western blot and flow cytometry were used to evaluate the polarization status of macrophages. RT-PCR, western blot or/and immunohistochemistry was used to determine the expression of circ_0003137, PTBP1, PLOD3 and epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) markers.

pmc-11493625.title: FOXO1-mediated autophagy regulation by miR-223 in sepsis-induced immunosuppression
pmc-11493625.creator: Guoan Xiang, Qi Li, Di Lian, Chengcheng Su, Xin Li, Shoulong Deng, Lixin Xie
pmc-11493625.description: IntroductionImmunosuppression is the main cause of the high mortality rate in patients with sepsis. The decrease in the number and dysfunction of CD4+ T lymphocytes is crucial to the immunosuppressed state of sepsis, in turn affecting the development and prognosis of sepsis. Autophagy has been shown to play an important role in the immune imbalance exhibited during sepsis.

pmc-11626344.title: Blumeria hordei affects volatile emission of susceptible and resistant barley plants and modifies the defense response of recipient plants
pmc-11626344.creator: Silvana Laupheimer, Andrea Ghirardo, Lisa Kurzweil, Baris Weber, Timo D. Stark, Corinna Dawid, Jörg‐Peter Schnitzler, Ralph Hückelhoven
pmc-11626344.description: The barley powdery mildew disease caused by the biotrophic fungus Blumeria hordei (Bh) poses enormous risks to crop production due to yield and quality losses. Plants and fungi can produce and release volatile organic compounds (VOCs) that serve as signals in plant communication and defense response to protect themselves.

pmc-12564076.title: A Neural-Glial Model of the ApoE-SORT1-FABP7 Axis Tied to Sleep Disruption and Alzheimer’s Disease Pathophysiology
pmc-12564076.creator: Carlos C Flores, Yool Lee, Christopher J Davis, Patrick Solverson, Jason R Gerstner, Angelika Chroni
pmc-12564076.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a complex neurodegenerative disorder where age, genetic factors and sleep disturbance significantly influence disease risk. Recent genome-wide association studies identified a C/T missense variant (rs141749679) in the sortilin (SORT1) gene linked to heightened AD risk, revealing SORT1’s role as a key player in the disease’s pathophysiology.

pmc-13028188.title: Tool Wear and Surface Finish in AISI 304 Stainless Steel Dry Turning with Cermet Inserts
pmc-13028188.creator: Laurence Colares Magalhães, Nelson Antenor Sorte, Marcelo Tramontin Souza, Armando Marques
pmc-13028188.description: The present study investigates the surface integrity and flank wear of uncoated cermet inserts during dry turning of AISI 304 stainless steel. Three-dimensional metrology techniques were employed to assess both surface roughness and cutting-tool flank wear. Cutting speed and feed rate were the process parameters varied in the experiments. Both parameters exhibited a significant influence on the final surface quality.

pmc-13069583.creator: Chernet T Mengistie, Biruk T Mengistie, Selam D Temesgen, Kalab Y Gete, Biruk Z Bekele, Elias G Bayu, Sileante M Tamru

pmc-13183023.title: Modeling Negative Symptom Domain Neurobiology: Protocol for an Observational, Transdiagnostic, Translational Study
pmc-13183023.creator: Dan Cătălin Oprea, Ilinca Untu, Diana-Sabina Vieru, Camelia Dascălu, Helene Speyer, Cristina Dobre, Ohad Green, Romeo Petru Dobrin, Michael Davidson, Jonathan Rabinowitz, Bogdan Ionel Tamba
pmc-13183023.description: BackgroundNegative symptoms (NS) such as anhedonia (reduced pleasure), avolition (reduced motivation), asociality (social withdrawal), blunted affect (diminished emotional expression), and alogia (poverty of speech) are associated with poor functional outcomes in psychiatric and neurological disorders and are an unmet treatment need. Current medication primarily targets positive or affective symptoms, leaving NS neurobiology unaddressed.

pmc-13619472.title: Efficacy and safety analysis of induction therapy for unresectable locally advanced non-small-cell lung cancer: a retrospective study based on IPTW
pmc-13619472.creator: Tianlong Chen, Hongxu Zhang, Hongtao Yin, Mingyan Li, Qian Zhang, Jiaao Liu, Hao Qi
pmc-13619472.description: BackgroundConcurrent chemoradiotherapy (cCRT) followed by consolidation immunotherapy constitutes the current standard of care for unresectable locally advanced non–small cell lung cancer (LA-NSCLC). Despite this approach, a substantial proportion of patients experience disease progression, underscoring the need for novel therapeutic strategies. This study was undertaken to evaluate whether induction chemoimmunotherapy administered prior to definitive CRT can improve clinical outcomes.

pmc-13629400.title: Solvent and Bar Coating Parameter Selection for Optimum Deposition of Perovskite Films at Low Temperatures under Ambient Conditions
pmc-13629400.creator: Carlos F. Arias-Ramos, Francisco E. Cancino-Gordillo, Diana Marcela Montoya, Paola G. Abrego-Martínez, Ari M. Vargas-Sotomayor, Asiel N. Corpus-Mendoza, Hailin Hu
pmc-13629400.description: The transition from small-area and atmosphere-controlled spin-coating to large-area bar coating in an uncontrolled ambient process requires a comprehensive understanding of the crystallization kinetics in perovskite precursor layers. In this work, we investigate the structural, optical, and photovoltaic properties of additive-free methylammonium lead triiodide (MAPbI3) films fabricated via bar coating without a glove box.
